text:
alex: Heads-up — after merging the fp8 capability probe + kernel-autopick changes, canary telemetry shows a regression on some long-seq KV workloads (seqlen >= 1536). A100 runs are fine; H100 canaries are ~10-15% slower on tail latency.

sarah: ugh. do you have the probe payload + which kernel path it picked?

alex: Pasted the probe & selector output from canary host:
```
probe: { sm: "sm90", tensor_cores: true, bf16: true, fp8: true }
selector: attention_path -> attention_fp8_prefetch_kv_v3
config: prefetch_size=64, kv_cache_mode=shared, batching.mode=continuous
perf: p99: 112ms (baseline 98ms), p50: 24ms (baseline 22ms) on seqlen=2048, batch=1
```

bench-bot: quick microbench shows the kernel itself is slightly faster for short sequences, but end-to-end we pay extra memcpy+prefetch cost as kv cache grows:
```
H100 canary (seqlen=2048):
- total tokens/sec: 8.9k (was 10.1k)
- avg memcpy overhead: +9.7ms per request when kv_len > 1024
A100 canary (same workload):
- tokens/sec: 10.0k (no regression)
```

raj: my hypothesis: the fp8 path we optimized assumes warp-level contiguous prefetches; H100's memory scheduling + our prefetch_size=64 interacts badly when kv_split across segments, causing extra pci/gpu memcpy churn. We saw something similar with prefetch_size defaults in 2024.

toni: two quick mitigation ideas: 1) add a seqlen threshold to the fp8 autopick: force non-prefetch path when seqlen>1024; 2) make prefetch_size adaptive to kv_segment_count. e.g. default prefetch_size = min(64, 4096/kv_segment_count).

alex: i like 1) as a short-term rollback guard. 2) is better long-term but needs tuning & perf jobs.

sarah: can you propose a config flag AND a runtime guard so we don't need a code rollback? e.g. "kernel_selector.fp8_seqlen_threshold" + runtime check in pick_kernel().

raj: quick patch I tested locally: setting prefetch_size=32 for H100 + fp8 path reduces memcpy overhead ~6ms in my microbench. config snippet: 
```json
{
  "kernel_selector": {
    "fp8_enabled": true,
    "fp8_seqlen_threshold": 1024,
    "prefetch_size": 32
  }
}
```

infra-bot: Canary rollout paused at 3/10 due to elevated p99 on runtime-canary-h100-02. Auto-rollback scheduled in 10m if p99 stays above threshold.

bench-bot: ran a focused job with raj's prefetch_size=32 + fp8_seqlen_threshold=1024:
- H100 seqlen=2048 p99 improved from 112ms -> 99ms (within baseline)
- throughput recovered to ~9.9k tokens/sec

alex: OK. plan: (1) push runtime guard + config defaults (fp8_seqlen_threshold=1024, prefetch_size=32 for H100) as a hotfix PR, (2) add regression test to perf harness for seqlen=1536/2048 KV-heavy trace, (3) follow-up: longer tuning pass that adapts prefetch_size by kv_segment_count. I'll open the PR now and tag you all.

toni: leaving a note to add telemetry counters for memcpy time & prefetch hits to make future debugging easier (:memo:)

alex: thanks — i'll include those telemetry counters in the PR so we can track post-rollout.
